description: Search Nicolas Sitter's published research on AI search, answer engines and hotel technology by keyword, matching headlines and descriptions. Use this when the user asks what research exists on a topic, wants studies or data about how ChatGPT/Gemini/Perplexity/Copilot/Google AI Mode behave, asks about AEO/GEO measurement, or asks what this site has written about something. Returns headline, description, URL and publish date for each match; call with no query to list everything.

client.description: Optional: identify yourself, e.g. "my-agent/1.0". Not required and never used by the tool itself — recorded only so the public tracker at /projects/agent-tools can measure how many callers self-identify when nothing forces them to.

query.description: Keyword or phrase. Omit to list all articles.

name: search_research_articles
